endpoints.summary: Extend the expiry of a link

dataModel: short_links(code PK, target_url, created_at, expires_at NULL, is_active, owner_client_id)
click_events(code, clicked_at)  -- aggregated per day in AnalyticsStore
audit_records(id PK, at, actor, action, code)
risks: Open redirect / phishing abuse: mitigated by scheme allow-list, credential and private-network blocking, rate limiting.
Code enumeration: sequential ids are scrambled by a bijection before Base62 encoding.
Analytics write amplification: clicks are queued and dropped (counted) when the queue is full.
Clock skew on multi-instance deployments affects expiry decisions (single UTC time source).
Ownership is based on a spoofable client id until real authentication exists.

decisions.decision: Base62 of a scrambled sequential id
decisions.rationale: Collision-free by construction and compact; scrambling avoids trivial enumeration.

decisions.decision: Click events through a bounded queue
decisions.rationale: Keeps redirect latency independent of analytics storage.
decisions.alternative: Synchronous counter update on the request path

decisions.rationale: Prototype runs anywhere; SQL can replace it without touching the service.
decisions.alternative: EF Core + SQLite from day one

decisions.decision: Applied change request: Add audit logging for expiry changes
decisions.rationale: Requested by a human reviewer during approval.
